column1: # Exact pinned client-go test evidence for Campaign 16 region-cache maintenance.

column8: note
The retained generation-aware channel is reused and can be replaced while maintenance stays single-owner; multi-connection selection, batch enablement, TLS, and live client-go parity remain external.
Address close permits generation-safe recreation and terminal close prevents reuse; tonic shutdown observation, in-flight cancellation, and live sockets remain external.
Generation replacement and stale-close rejection are translated, but the original live reconnect and resend sequence is not reproduced.
The one worker uses coalesced wakeups and joined shutdown without a per-store loop; the original concurrent tonic connection close stress remains external.
Trigger coalescing, single-driver execution, and joined shutdown are translated; production intervals, real PD/TiKV work, and race-detector parity remain external.
In-place store refresh and generation transition are exercised on the canonical cache; the complete source transition table and live PD resolution remain external.
Strict TTL entry state composes with bounded rotating GC; production timing and concurrent lookup races remain external.
Cache-issued peer observations reject stale topology and canonical invalidation remains available; a live multi-region store failure is not reproduced.
Address refresh advances store generation in place and retains one cache identity; real disconnect, reconnect, and request replay remain external.
Start-inside-region, zero limit, raw coverage, leader filtering, and leader-only retry are translated; live PD scan scheduling remains external.
A cache-issued observation captured before a down-peer topology change is rejected against the new selectable vector; live send failure and PD reload remain external.
A cache-issued observation captured before a peer becomes witness is rejected against the changed selectable vector; live transport feedback remains external.
Leaderless scan replies are filtered only after raw coverage validation and empty results retry PD leader only; live router redirection remains external.
GC scans no more than its bound and resumes from the next key through the sole background driver; production timing and concurrent mutation stress remain external.
Canonical slow-score state remains preserved across maintenance, but live background sampling and the complete source timing matrix remain external.
Address refresh mutates one canonical store and advances generation; a real health RPC racing an address change remains external.
TiKV-side slow facts remain in the canonical health state, while live probe ingestion and production decay timing remain external.
Tri-state health and decaying load remain canonical; the complete live health-check lifecycle and metrics remain external.
The sole cache accepts in-place store refresh and tombstone expiry without a second map; real probe publication and concurrent request selection remain external.
Delayed reload state composes with bounded GC and canonical lookup; the original split RPC timing sequence remains external.
An unreachable or tombstoned store is resolved in place and dependent regions expire; live liveness probes and label refresh from PD remain external.
Metadata refresh preserves store identity while updating address and generation; full label state and a live store restart remain external.
Direct ID lookup does not publish, public lookup publishes exactly once, and mismatched replies stay out of cache; the original eleven-API and live-PD matrix remains external.
Direct nonpublishing and public publishing region-ID paths are distinguished with mismatch rejection; live PD routing remains external.
Canonical in-place store recovery and generation refresh are represented, but the real three-store stop, probe, and request-recovery sequence is not reproduced.
